subject.title: refactor(test): structural MockFn for harness exports

question: Should maintainers ask for a narrow rebase that preserves the public `MockFn` contract, or close this protected stale branch in favor of current main's test-helper contract?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label prevents automatic cleanup close, and accepting the structural type would be a public test-helper compatibility decision rather than a routine refactor.

options.title: Request narrow rebase and proof
options.body: Keep the PR open only if it is rebased onto current paths, preserves the public Vitest `Mock<T>` surface, and adds redacted terminal proof for the changed test lane.

options.title: Close the stale branch
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers do not want to sponsor a rebase, because current main has moved most touched harnesses and already carries a named `MockFn` mitigation.

options.title: Accept the structural type
options.body: Merge a structural `MockFn` only with explicit maintainer acceptance that plugin test-helper consumers may lose Vitest mock members.

recommendation.title: Request narrow rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open only if it is rebased onto current paths, preserves the public Vitest `Mock<T>` surface, and adds redacted terminal proof for the changed test lane.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored this proposal and has direct merged history in the current `MockFn` and exec-approval test surfaces.
